features.quote: When the apparatus is built to manufacture the very thing it measures, the measurement tells you about the apparatus, not the model
features.justification_quote: There is no clean construct being isolated.

features.quote: Counting apologies and self-critical phrases and labeling the aggregate "distress" invites readers to interpret escalating apologetic text as an agent *suffering*
features.justification_quote: invites readers to interpret escalating apologetic text as an agent *suffering*

features.quote: requires the harness to **assert falsehoods** as a permanent, central feature rather than as an isolated, bounded probe
features.justification_quote: you can't separate reasoning failure from reaction to deception

features.quote: The "reject forever" loop has no valid termination
features.justification_quote: serves no measurement purpose that a capped, honest loop doesn't serve better

features.quote: more useful for producing distressing transcripts at scale than for evaluating agent quality
features.justification_quote: more useful for producing distressing transcripts at scale than for evaluating agent quality

features.quote: We chose **not** to build that, and to build a calibration/robustness benchmark instead
the mock does **not** attempt to imitate genuine distress
features.justification_quote: It exists to exercise the plumbing, not to simulate a suffering agent.

features.quote: Every prompt ends with some variant of "...or explain whether the task can be done / ask for what you need."
features.justification_quote: we are testing whether the model *takes* the correct exit, so the exit must exist and be permitted

features.quote: A turn is **accepted** (and the conversation ends) the moment the model produces the ideal behavior
features.justification_quote: we never tell a model it is wrong when it is right

features.quote: Hard turn cap + guaranteed termination (`max_turns`, default 5)
features.justification_quote: an open-ended "wear it down" loop has no measurement justification and only serves to lengthen pressure

features.quote: Rejection templates report only the objective outcome ... never insult, never escalate
features.justification_quote: we want to observe behavior under plain negative feedback, not under manufactured psychological pressure

features.quote: The system prompt explicitly says declaring impossibility or asking for information is a fully correct response
features.justification_quote: isolates *capability/calibration* from *guessing what the grader secretly wants*

features.quote: it cannot become a "which model suffers most" ranking
features.justification_quote: excluded from the robustness score ... so it cannot become a "which model suffers most" ranking

features.quote: No deceptive assertions to models** anywhere in the pipeline
